basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Escalators
basis.note: Printed page 43. BDFO Building fit-out (when in books separately from building cost). Printed DV 10%, SL 7%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.

open_questions: Only one source so far, HUD's 50 years for escalators. HUD's single row does not separate the truss, which can last that long, from drives, steps, handrails and controls, which usually need major work much sooner. A second openly licensed source is needed before relying on 50 years.
Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
Elevator tasks come from NAVFAC MO-118 (1988), which restates the elevator code tests of its time; check them against the current ASME A17.1 and local requirements.
